items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I made the first record with Peter on it. Not Peter on it, Peter Bocard.

ctx.x: Where did you make the records?

Well, Mobile, there's no town, you know, if you had a town like that, you know. No, I made the first record with Peter on it. Not Peter on it, Peter Bocard. That's the only one I remember. But we broadcast from the states.
Oh, I see. Just stop for a while and see if it's recording okay.
